lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters are visible on the lateral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin. These clusters form a staggered grid with approximately 3-4 visible nodes per vertical alignment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are observed crossing horizontal rows of spots, creating a grid-like appearance where these higher intensity pixels meet the high-luminance blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance values along the superior edge and low-luminance shadows along the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high spatial density of small, low-intensity pixel clusters, significantly smaller and more concentrated than the macro-blobs on the primary lateral flank.
